description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Jedrick Wills Jr. has signed with the Buffalo Bills practice squad according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Wills Jr. will look to offer Buffalo some added depth to the offensive line after the former first-round pick of the Cleveland Browns was released from the Chicago Bears last week.
items.title: Jedrick Wills Jr. signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaydon Blue is signing with the Eagles practice squad.
items.impact: Blue went unclaimed on waivers after he was waived by Dallas. He'll add depth in the Eagles backfield.
items.title: Jaydon Blue signs with Eagles practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Las Vegas Raiders released CB Decamerion Richardson.
items.impact: Richardson will seek another opportunity heading into the season.
items.title: Decamerion Richardson released by Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders re-signed DL Shy Tuttle.
items.impact: Tuttle will add depth on the defensive line for Washington.
items.title: Shy Tuttle re-signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders re-signed CB Fabian Moreau.
items.impact: Moreau will add depth in the secondary for Washington.
items.title: Fabian Moreau re-signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders placed Laremy Tunsil on injured reserve.
items.impact: Tunsil will undergo surgery to address his torn triceps.
items.title: Laremy Tunsil placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders placed Jer'Zhan Newton on injured reserve.
